id="collapse-1-899535" class="awb-toggles__collapse"><div class="awb-toggles__body post-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Avada One Essential gives you everything you need to build your website, all in one package. From the first layout to the finished site, it covers the full building process without needing extra tools.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Avada One Pro takes it to the next level with three powerful additions: <strong>Sales</strong> tools, <strong>Marketing</strong> tools, and <strong>AI</strong> tools that work together to help you grow. Below you can find some of the additional tools listed.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Sales (for Woo stores)</strong><br>Abandoned Cart Recovery, Wishlists, Product Compare, Price Drop Alerts, Review Reminders.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Marketing</strong><br>A/B Testing with Revenue Analytics, Visitor Analytics and Journeys, Email Campaigns and Contacts, Designed Emails, Reliable Delivery, Smart Links and Keyword Auto-Linking.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"><strong>AI</strong><br>AI Chat in the Live Builder, On-Brand Writing, AI Image Generation and Editing, Design Tools, AI Chat in the Dashboard.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Once you have chosen your plan, choose the Tier that matches the number of live websites you run. Local, development, and staging sites do not count. If your needs change, you can switch at any time.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div></details></div><div class="awb-toggles__panel awb-toggles__panel--divider awb-faq__item" data-terms="purchase-avada support-most-wanted"><span class="entry-title" style="display: none;">How Does The Avada One Subscription Work?</span><span class="vcard" style="display: none;"><span class="fn"><a href="https://avada.com/author/mark/" rel="author">Mark</a></span></span><span class="updated" style="display:none;">2026-10-19T13:19:28+00:00</span><details class="awb-toggles__details" name="accordian-1"><summary class="awb-toggles__header"><div id="faq_1-899533" class="awb-toggles__title"><span class="awb-toggles__trigger awb-toggles__trigger--icon-right"><span class="awb-toggles__icons" aria-hidden="true"><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--active awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__minus"><path d="M778.189 448h-532.429c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h532.429c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--inactive awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__plus"><path d="M778.189 448h-215.040v-215.040c0-28.262-22.886-30.72-51.2-30.72-28.262 0-51.2 2.406-51.2 30.72v215.040h-214.989c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h214.989v215.040c0 28.262 22.938 30.72 51.2 30.72 28.314 0 51.2-2.458 51.2-30.72v-215.040h215.040c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i></span><span class="awb-toggles__label awb-toggles__label--icon-right">How Does The Avada One Subscription Work?</span></span></div></summary><div id="collapse-1-899533" class="awb-toggles__collapse"><div class="awb-toggles__body post-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Avada One is billed annually. Your subscription combines a Plan, Essential or Pro, which defines your features, with a Tier, which defines how many websites you can use it on. As long as your subscription is active, you get all updates, support, prebuilt websites, and Avada Studio content.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">You can upgrade, downgrade, or switch your Plan or Tier at any time, with automatic proration, and manage everything in your <a href="https://my.avada.com" data-type="link" data-id="https://my.avada.com">My Avada</a> account. See all details on our <a href="https://avada.com/pricing" data-type="link" data-id="avada.com/pricing">pricing page</a>.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div></details></div><div class="awb-toggles__panel awb-toggles__panel--divider awb-faq__item" data-terms="purchase-avada"><span class="entry-title" style="display: none;">What Happens To My Websites If My Subscription Ends?</span><span class="vcard" style="display: none;"><span class="fn"><a href="https://avada.com/author/mark/" rel="author">Mark</a></span></span><span class="updated" style="display:none;">2026-10-19T07:52:31+00:00</span><details class="awb-toggles__details" name="accordian-1"><summary class="awb-toggles__header"><div id="faq_1-899537" class="awb-toggles__title"><span class="awb-toggles__trigger awb-toggles__trigger--icon-right"><span class="awb-toggles__icons" aria-hidden="true"><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--active awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__minus"><path d="M778.189 448h-532.429c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h532.429c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--inactive awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__plus"><path d="M778.189 448h-215.040v-215.040c0-28.262-22.886-30.72-51.2-30.72-28.262 0-51.2 2.406-51.2 30.72v215.040h-214.989c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h214.989v215.040c0 28.262 22.938 30.72 51.2 30.72 28.314 0 51.2-2.458 51.2-30.72v-215.040h215.040c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i></span><span class="awb-toggles__label awb-toggles__label--icon-right">What Happens To My Websites If My Subscription Ends?</span></span></div></summary><div id="collapse-1-899537" class="awb-toggles__collapse"><div class="awb-toggles__body post-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Your websites keep working. Nothing on their frontend is removed or switched off.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">What ends is access to the parts that depend on an active Subscription:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>Product updates and support.</li>



<li>Patches and hotfixes.</li>



<li>Prebuilt website imports and Avada Studio imports.</li>



<li>AI features, for Pro plans.</li>



<li>Sales and marketing features, for Pro plans. You can no longer access or change their settings. What you already set up stays in place, so your websites keep working, but some features, such as campaigns and emails, no longer work in their full scope.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">You can renew at any time through your <strong><a href="https://my.avada.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">My Avada account</a></strong> to restore full access.</p>
</div></div></details></div><div class="awb-toggles__panel awb-toggles__panel--divider awb-faq__item" data-terms="purchase-avada support-most-wanted"><span class="entry-title" style="display: none;">What Is Included With Avada One?</span><span class="vcard" style="display: none;"><span class="fn"><a href="https://avada.com/author/mark/" rel="author">Mark</a></span></span><span class="updated" style="display:none;">2026-10-19T13:15:37+00:00</span><details class="awb-toggles__details" name="accordian-1"><summary class="awb-toggles__header"><div id="faq_1-899539" class="awb-toggles__title"><span class="awb-toggles__trigger awb-toggles__trigger--icon-right"><span class="awb-toggles__icons" aria-hidden="true"><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--active awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__minus"><path d="M778.189 448h-532.429c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h532.429c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--inactive awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__plus"><path d="M778.189 448h-215.040v-215.040c0-28.262-22.886-30.72-51.2-30.72-28.262 0-51.2 2.406-51.2 30.72v215.040h-214.989c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h214.989v215.040c0 28.262 22.938 30.72 51.2 30.72 28.314 0 51.2-2.458 51.2-30.72v-215.040h215.040c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i></span><span class="awb-toggles__label awb-toggles__label--icon-right">What Is Included With Avada One?</span></span></div></summary><div id="collapse-1-899539" class="awb-toggles__collapse"><div class="awb-toggles__body post-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Every Avada One subscription includes:</p>



<ul class="wp-block-list">
<li>The complete Avada One Website Builder with <strong>120+ design and layout elements.</strong></li>



<li><strong>110+ prebuilt websites</strong> and <strong>600+ Avada Studio content items</strong>, all importable with a click and 100% customizable.</li>



<li>All product updates for as long as your subscription is active.</li>



<li>Hands-on support from our in-house team of experts.</li>



<li>Patches and hotfixes.</li>



<li>A My Avada account to manage your subscription, websites, and support tickets, with local and staging sites not counting toward your Tier.</li>



<li>Access to our Help Center with <strong><a href="https://avada.com/help-center/" data-type="link" data-id="https://avada.com/help-center/">550+ help files</a></strong> and <strong><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@AvadaVideos" data-type="link" data-id="www.youtube.com/@AvadaVideos">300+ video tutorials</a></strong>.</li>



<li>Custom Branding functionality.</li>
</ul>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">The Pro plan adds <strong>sales</strong>, <strong>marketing</strong>, and <strong>AI </strong>features.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div></details></div><div class="awb-toggles__panel awb-toggles__panel--divider awb-faq__item" data-terms="purchase-avada"><span class="entry-title" style="display: none;">Are Prebuilt Websites And Avada Studio Items Customizable?</span><span class="vcard" style="display: none;"><span class="fn"><a href="https://avada.com/author/mark/" rel="author">Mark</a></span></span><span class="updated" style="display:none;">2026-10-19T08:02:17+00:00</span><details class="awb-toggles__details" name="accordian-1"><summary class="awb-toggles__header"><div id="faq_1-899541" class="awb-toggles__title"><span class="awb-toggles__trigger awb-toggles__trigger--icon-right"><span class="awb-toggles__icons" aria-hidden="true"><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--active awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__minus"><path d="M778.189 448h-532.429c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h532.429c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--inactive awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__plus"><path d="M778.189 448h-215.040v-215.040c0-28.262-22.886-30.72-51.2-30.72-28.262 0-51.2 2.406-51.2 30.72v215.040h-214.989c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h214.989v215.040c0 28.262 22.938 30.72 51.2 30.72 28.314 0 51.2-2.458 51.2-30.72v-215.040h215.040c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i></span><span class="awb-toggles__label awb-toggles__label--icon-right">Are Prebuilt Websites And Avada Studio Items Customizable?</span></span></div></summary><div id="collapse-1-899541" class="awb-toggles__collapse"><div class="awb-toggles__body post-content">
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Yes, every prebuilt website and every Avada Studio item is 100% customizable. Our in-house team designs them to save you time and give you a professional starting point.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Once imported, you can change the imagery, text, styling, and layouts to your liking with Avada One.</p>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph"></p>
</div></div></details></div><div class="awb-toggles__panel awb-toggles__panel--divider awb-faq__item" data-terms="purchase-avada"><span class="entry-title" style="display: none;">How Do I Get Avada One Support?</span><span class="vcard" style="display: none;"><span class="fn"><a href="https://avada.com/author/mark/" rel="author">Mark</a></span></span><span class="updated" style="display:none;">2026-10-19T08:15:20+00:00</span><details class="awb-toggles__details" name="accordian-1"><summary class="awb-toggles__header"><div id="faq_1-899550" class="awb-toggles__title"><span class="awb-toggles__trigger awb-toggles__trigger--icon-right"><span class="awb-toggles__icons" aria-hidden="true"><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--active awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__minus"><path d="M778.189 448h-532.429c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h532.429c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i><i class="awb-toggles__icon awb-toggles__icon--inactive awb-ico" aria-hidden="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="awb-ico__svg awb-ico__svg_avada-icons" viewBox="0 0 1024 1024" data-awb-icon="avada-icons__plus"><path d="M778.189 448h-215.040v-215.040c0-28.262-22.886-30.72-51.2-30.72-28.262 0-51.2 2.406-51.2 30.72v215.040h-214.989c-28.314 0-30.72 22.938-30.72 51.2s2.406 51.2 30.72 51.2h214.989v215.040c0 28.262 22.938 30.72 51.2 30.72 28.314 0 51.2-2.458 51.2-30.72v-215.040h215.040c28.314 0 30.771-22.938 30.771-51.2s-2.458-51.2-30.771-51.2z"></path></svg></i></span><span class="awb-toggles__label awb-toggles__label--icon-right">How Do I Get Avada One Support?</span></span></div></summary><div id="collapse-1-899550" class="awb-toggles__collapse"><div class="awb-toggles__body post-content">

<li>You must <a href="https://avada.com/documentation/how-to-register-for-my-avada/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">register</a> for a My Avada support account to access Avada support.</li>



<li>Once your My Avada support account is set up, please <a href="https://my.avada.com/submit-a-ticket/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">submit support tickets here</a>.</li>



<li>For detailed information on using your My Avada support account, please see this <a href="https://avada.com/documentation/how-to-use-my-avada/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">help file and explainer video</a>.</li>
